title: Pyrometer
summary: PYROMETER, noun [Gr., fire; measure.] 1. An instrument for measuring the expansion of bodies by heat. 2. An instrument for measuring degrees of heat above those indicated by the mercurial thermometer;

inlines.v: PYROMETER, noun [Gr., fire; measure.] 1. An instrument for measuring the expansion of bodies by heat. 2. An instrument for measuring degrees of heat above those indicated by the mercurial thermometer; as the pyrometer of Wedgewood.
